name: Festival Panen
description: Warga mengadakan pesta panen raya desa, harga jual komoditas meningkat pesat!
description_en: Villagers celebrate a grand harvest festival, increasing commodity market prices!

name: Hujan Tropis
description: Hujan tropis menyirami persawahan dan mempercepat masa pertumbuhan tanaman.
description_en: Tropical rain nourishes all fields and accelerates crop growth.

name: Musim Kemarau
description: Musim kemarau memperlambat pertumbuhan tanaman, siram sawah secara berkala.
description_en: Dry weather slows down crop growth; regular watering is advised.

name: Hama Tanaman
description: Hama menyerang sebagian ladang, memperlambat pertumbuhan tanaman sementara.
description_en: Pests attack crops, temporarily slowing agricultural growth.

name: Banjir Sungai
description: Debit sungai meningkat tajam, menghambat aktivitas produksi pabrik desa.
description_en: High river water levels temporarily slow down factory operations.

name: Wisata Kampung
description: Wisatawan berdatangan menikmati panorama desa, mendongkrak harga jual produk!
description_en: Tourists visit the scenic village, significantly boosting sales prices!

name: Kurang Tenaga Kerja
description: Sebagian pekerja libur musiman, memperlambat laju pengolahan industri.
description_en: Seasonal worker shortages temporarily reduce factory output.
